result.comment: Planning is complete for two stories: explain and recover rejected creation approval/preparation commands, then recover successful intake without duplicate effects or renewed authority. Scope is settled; no product questions remain. Implementation, executed evidence, factory publication and readiness remain pending.

plan.summary: Creation-command queue recovery within the owner-approved boundary: classify confirmed rejection separately from transient/unknown/uncertain failure; retain original outcomes and deliver safe recoverable guidance before consuming rejected input; recover successful proposal/approval intake before fresh eligibility checks. Preserve existing identity, grammar and authority restrictions. No global retry change, auto-skip, alerts, operator recovery command or deployment.

acceptance_criteria.text: An eligible malformed approval comment followed by a valid instruction yields one safe actionable rejection reply, no owner intent, approval grant, publication, task execution or mode-change effect, consumption only after confirmed reporting, and eventual execution of the later instruction.

An eligible malformed preparation comment followed by a valid instruction yields one safe actionable rejection reply, no proposal admission/publication/work effect from the rejected input, consumption only after confirmed reporting, and eventual execution of the later instruction.

Cover confirmed malformed syntax/payload, unsupported payload version, invalid fields/limits, missing/wrong/ambiguous/malformed Research selection, explicitly disabled loaded creation capability, confirmed absent/expired/superseded/mismatched/ineligible proposal and invalid owner controls reaching trusted creation handling. Guidance names the command and safe reason; syntax guidance describes existing grammar without generating an executable approval; mode guidance asks for one Research selection; capability guidance identifies operator configuration; proposal guidance asks for a current eligible proposal and fresh comment. No raw payload, secret or hidden proposal content is exposed.

Storage/infrastructure failures, rate limits, forge outages, shutdown, unknown internal failures, unexplained missing components, and uncertain persistence/remote effects are not input rejection and do not consume the source. Later comments remain ordered and resume after resolution. A broad authority error wrapping failed storage observation remains retryable; only verified policy refusal can be rejected.

Before dispatch, durably retain one immutable rejection outcome bound to trusted repository/task/session/comment identity, command kind, reason, exact bounded safe reply and stable delivery association. Retain remote confirmation and delivery/consumption lifecycle in existing report state. Recover before fresh parsing or eligibility checks; edits removing the command prefix, mode/configuration/proposal changes, restart, or a gap between outcome retention and delivery creation cannot alter or strand that outcome. Failure to retain it leaves the source pending without sending an unretained reply.

A proven failure before dispatch, successful posting with lost response, restart before/after delivery and failed consumption recover to one confirmed diagnostic and consumption without duplicate replies or premature queue advancement. Uncertain absence stays pending. Confirmation requires matching bot, destination, exact retained content and delivery identity; counterfeit markers/conflicting content do not authorize consumption. An unrelated legacy task-only report does not prevent creation-specific rejection delivery; global report reconciliation is not weakened.

Preserve numeric owner filtering, bot exclusion, exact lowercase 64-hex approval hash and relationship grammar, preparation decoder/version/limits, source/relationship binding, freshness and edit restrictions. Filtered identities retain existing record-and-consume behavior without new diagnostic/execution. A retained rejected command cannot execute after mode/configuration/proposal changes; corrections require a new comment.

Existing queued unconsumed creation comments receive corrected rejection/recovery handling when encountered, without manual watermark repair. Previously consumed comments are never replayed, and unrelated command-family behavior remains unchanged.

architecture.summary: Add immutable creation rejection intake within existing owners and route it through the existing recoverable reporting/consumption protocol. Resolve trusted retained outcomes before mutable command parsing and controls.

constraints: All SQL and transactions stay in internal/store; use a numbered embedded migration if needed, context-first accessors and the existing single-connection SQLite pool.
No transaction spans forge I/O; daemon owns retry timing, turn owns one-turn orchestration. No new package, dependency, timer or goroutine is required.
Reuse durable report bytes, stable identity, possibly-sent state and exact remote confirmation; never downgrade uncertain effects to rejection.
Tests use ordinary _test.go files, real temporary SQLite/httptest for durable I/O, hand-written fakes for unit dependencies, deterministic synchronization and no integration build tag/name.
Implement runs make check on the final snapshot and retains executed evidence. Offline checks do not prove deployment, historical incident reproduction or authentic host/nested-agent behavior.

decisions.decision: Use a narrow creation-specific outcome, not global error-message classification.
decisions.reason: Authority sentinels can conceal failed storage observations; only verified refusal may release ordering.

decisions.decision: Retain outcome and exact safe reply before dispatch, with recovery across the outcome/report gap.
decisions.reason: Mutable mode, payload and configuration cannot erase or replace the decision after restart.

decisions.decision: Reuse existing report confirmation and narrow creation-specific legacy-report handling.
decisions.reason: An unrelated old task reply must not strand new rejection reporting, while uncertain remote effects remain conservatively pending.

acceptance_criteria.text: Valid preparation durably associates its trusted source with the original admitted proposal before reporting, and recovers that same proposal/presentation after report failure, restart or source/mode/configuration changes without duplicate proposals, false rejection, regenerated content, refreshed proposal state or replacing a newer current proposal. Reporting confirmation precedes consumption. Valid approval retains original intent and consumes without a new success reply or launching work. An uncertain admission is reconciled before any new admission or final rejection.

Successful approval followed by failed consumption recovers original admission by trusted source identity before fresh parsing, mode/configuration or proposal eligibility checks, including after expiry, supersession or edited source text. Existing pre-change owner intents are recoverable without requiring a new journal row. Recovery causes no duplicate intent, false rejection, extended expiry, renewed authority or bypass of later grant-binding checks. Existing numeric identity filtering still precedes recovery; failure to observe the original outcome remains pending.

decisions.decision: Keep successful recovery separate from new admission.
decisions.reason: Acknowledging an original intent after expiry is safe only if it neither extends expiry nor bypasses later grant-binding checks.

decisions.decision: Do not reuse run IDs as source comment IDs or re-retain an old proposal during recovery.
decisions.reason: Source associations have distinct ownership and restoring an older proposal must not overwrite newer current proposal state.

decisions.decision: Find existing pre-change owner intents without requiring the new journal.
decisions.reason: An already admitted approval with failed consumption must remain recoverable across rollout.
